key_empirical_findings: Swiggy Instamart AOV vs CM level correlation is r=0.5531 (p=0.0972), but detrended first-difference correlation collapses to r=0.1399 (p=0.7194), proving AOV expansion does not synchronously drive margin turnaround.
Dark store count vs QC GOV exhibits r=0.9922 (p<0.001) for Blinkit and r=0.9856 (p<0.001) for Instamart, surviving FDR.
Food Delivery AOV vs CM exhibits weak correlation (r=0.4811, p=0.1593), failing FDR.
